$comment: Single source of truth for store publishing. Each key is an app UI locale (must be one of SUPPORTED_LOCALES in lectorium/i18n/index.ts). Listing a locale here means we publish it; adding a language to the stores = add one entry (+ run translate-titles / translate-store-copy). Consumed by the screenshot pipeline (modules/tools/screenshots/config.ts) and fastlane (modules/apps/mobile/fastlane/Fastfile). Fields: play = Google Play locale code (null = not published on Play); appStore = App Store Connect locale code (null = store does not support this language, e.g. Serbian); capture = generate marketing screenshots; canonical = hand-authored copy that auto-translation must never overwrite.
